title: Bible study session and cell group at Weegol's Garden. Last week, i was asked by one of the attendees "pastor john, i want to be nearer to God, but i don't know how to pray". So, today i discussed to them "the Lord's Prayer" the prayer that Jesus taught to His disciples.
paragraphs: Bible study session and cell group at Weegol's Garden. Last week, i was asked by one of the attendees "pastor john, i want to be nearer to God, but i don't know how to pray". So, today i discussed to them "the Lord's Prayer" the prayer that Jesus taught to His disciples.

Thank you Lord God for the opportunity to share your word, bless these people as they continue to walk in your path, and bless also the owner of the establishment Jeremiah Betia Calo for letting us use his place and his workers for the advancement of your kingdom.
Please continue to use me Lord and guide me on my steps and decisions so i can always Glorify your name and not me.
As always, this is to Glorify God and for the advancement of His will and Kingdom.
